items.title: Iraq ranks third among Arab gold holders
items.desc: Shafaq News- Baghdad Iraq ranked third among Arab countries in gold reserves, holding 175.6 metric tons in September 2026, up from 162.7 tons a year earlier, according to World Gold Council figures. Saudi Arabia led the Arab rankings with 323.1 tons, followed by Lebanon with 286.8 tons. Algeria ranked fourth with 173.6 tons, ahead of Libya with 146.7 tons, Egypt with 129.7 tons and Qatar with 116.
